title: One Suitcase and a Letter
subtitle: 大学与升学 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 大学与升学（生活与学习·学校生活）
meta: 主题语境：大学与升学（生活与学习·学校生活）　|　核心词汇：college　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 college 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1963 my mother ① went to college with one suitcase and a letter she had not read, and she said the going was the whole of the leaving. The ② college, meaning the building and not the town, stood at the end of a long road and stayed there; college, she said, is the only thing in a life that is judged by how far it is from home.

Every ③ college in that town had the same gate, and the ④ college at the end, meaning the one she chose and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever wrote about twice. College, my grandmother said, is nine parts leaving and one part somebody willing to write home; my mother said the leaving is the part that fills the letter.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the whole college was the whole of the evening, meaning the people and not the building. The ⑥ college, meaning the people and not any of that, is the only thing in an evening that everybody belongs to and nobody names; college, he said, is either something you enter or the only word that means both a building and the people in it. She said the people are the part they remember.

By 1971 the ⑦ college had become a name on a certificate, and the certificate had become an argument about who was allowed to sign. The ⑧ college of the whole thing, my mother wrote in September, was one suitcase and thirty years of letters; college, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to write home. He said the writing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ college I remember is the one at the end, which she entered in 1977 and is still described as the furthest in the county. A ⑩ college, my grandmother said in 1979, is the only thing that improves by being left; every college, she said, is a leaving that has agreed to look like a building. She said the leaving was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 学院（指那座建筑本身，与那个镇相对）
C. 固定搭配：go to college 上大学
D. n. 学院（指那个镇上每一所）
E. n. 学院（指末尾那一所）
F. n. 学会；专业机构（签发证书的机构）
G. n. 全体师生；同窗（抽象：学院里的人）
H. n. 学业；那段求学（抽象总称）

items.q: went to college with one suitcase
The college, meaning the building and not the town
the whole college was the whole of the evening
the college had become a name on a certificate
The college of the whole thing
A college, my grandmother said in 1979

answers.why: go to college 意为“上大学”，1963 年母亲带着一只提箱和一封没读过的信去上大学。
college 意为“学院”，指那座建筑本身而不是那个镇，它立在长路的尽头。
college 指那个镇上每一所学院，每一所都有同样的大门。
college 指末尾那一所（她选的那一所），是唯一有人写过两次的。
college 意为“全体师生、同窗”，父亲说整个学院就是那个傍晚的全部，指的是学院里的人。
college 为抽象用法，指学院里的人而不是那座建筑，是傍晚里人人都归属、却无人点名的东西。
college 意为“学会、专业机构”（签发证书的机构），到 1971 年这所学院成了证书上的一个名字。
college 意为“学业、那段求学”，母亲九月写道，整件事说到底是一只提箱和三十年的信。
college 意为“学院”，我记得的是末尾那一所，她 1977 年入学，至今仍被说成全县最远的。
college 为抽象总称，祖母说一所学院是唯一会因为被离开而变好的东西。

那所学院，指的是那座建筑而不是那个镇，立在长路的尽头，并且一直立在那儿。（college）
那个镇上每一所学院都有同样的大门。（college）

父亲说整个学院就是那个傍晚的全部，指的是学院里的人而不是那座建筑。（college）
1979 年祖母说，一所学院是唯一会因为被离开而变好的东西。（college）

The college, meaning the building and not the town, stood at the end of a long road and stayed there.
Every college in that town had the same gate.
The college at the end, meaning the one she chose and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever wrote about twice.
My father said the whole college was the whole of the evening, meaning the people and not the building.
